independent_finding.source_fact: A remaining Tmpdir entry reads process TMPDIR during the original can_read_path_with_cwd evaluation; cloning and project-roots materialization do not freeze it.
independent_finding.counterexample: A coherent path observation combined later with a changed dynamic allow root can accept an inode that was never at an allowed current path during the stated schedule.
independent_finding.required_extra_condition: The schedule requires an actor able to change the process environment. Filesystem mutation authority alone is insufficient.
independent_finding.resolution: A future constructor must establish immutable retained policy-resolution inputs, reject an unsupported policy class, or propose an explicit separately reviewed semantic materialization boundary.

missing_inputs: An actual trusted executor-owned resolver/root and topology producer with a stated lifetime and deployment scope.
An admission boundary covering every retained dynamic policy input and exact deny-alias dependence.
Actual delegation support, caller eligibility, ownership, LSM and filesystem conditions for the admitted file.
An integrated same-inode/common-instant bounded-read implementation preserving the original positive and negative oracles.
